The '''Eddel''', or '''Eddelians''', were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known for their quick wit. They were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Fehern]], a hospitable<ref name="SWGK" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Fehern system/Legends|Fehern system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SWGK" /> The Eddelians traveled throughout the Trax [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|259|Fehern}}</ref> and their distinctively styled Eddelian [[Starship/Legends|starships]], carrying Eddelian [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], were a common sight in neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="SWGK" />

The Eddelians were targeted by the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as part of its [[High Human Culture/Legends|pro-Human]], anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Speciesism|rhetoric]]. The Empire [[Eddelian-Empire War|declared war]] on the Eddelians and decimated the species, subjugating the few thousand survivors of the conflict.<ref name="SWGK" /> The Empire took over their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and many [[Human/Legends|Humans]] immigrated there. The remaining Eddelians were forced to serve those colonists as [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] workers. The Empire also destroyed most Eddelian technology during the conflict.<ref name="SWGK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eddelians were first mentioned in the [[1991]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]'', written by [[Bill Smith]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SWGK" />
